notes: ADDED 2026-11-10 as the missing base record for webAI-Official/TwIL-8B, whose card publishes LiveCodeBench v6 81.6 against this model — the derivative could not be recorded without its base. Dense decoder (GraniteForCausalLM), built on ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-base, Apache-2.0. Params 8.79B read from safetensors.total (8,791,592,960, BF16). Geometry from config.json: 40 layers, hidden 4096, 32 attention heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim absent from config and derived as 4096/32 = 128 (matches the card's 'attention head size 128' table); GQA ratio 32/8 = 4. KV basis: 40 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 327,680 B/token (320 KiB). All 20 benchmark rows are the card's own '8B Dense' column; vendor_claim is true for every one and no independent run exists. GDPval is printed as 1189 on the card's own point scale rather than a percentage and is therefore NOT recorded as a benchmark row. MMLU-ProX lite is IBM's internal variant, noted because it is not comparable to public MMLU-ProX numbers. Two release dates conflict: the card says 2026-08-25, the HF repo was created 2026-08-07; the card date is used. Worth knowing for the TwIL-8B comparison: this base prints IFBench (prompt) 79.33, so a derivative claiming 74.4 on the same test is a regression on that row even where it gains on LiveCodeBench.
